judgment.notes: Defines exactly the time partial of u on positive times with Euclidean vector codomain. The dummy differentiation variable is bound by the derivative expression. The explicit zero-on-nondifferentiability convention makes this a total notation, not an assertion of differentiability; H002 supplies regularity where used. No extra hypothesis or property is hidden.

The second time partial is the time derivative of the already defined ut; domain, codomain and total convention agree with D001. D001 is the stated dependency. Smoothness is not built into the definition and is provided through H002/N002 in consuming arguments.

The index ranges over exactly the n standard spatial coordinates; each section has domain ℝ^n×(0,∞) and values in ℝ^m. Further partial notation means differentiation of the stated functions, not a mixed-derivative commutation assertion. Such commutation is instead exported by N002. The dependency on D001 accounts for the notation involving ut.

The vector Laplacian is exactly the finite sum of the repeated spatial partials of D003, component by component. Its sign and coefficient match the original normality equation. No elliptic or differential identity is assumed by defining this finite sum.

scope: Coverage is reviewer-reported; reading alone is not mathematical assessment.
